title: Bevel split card
description: One full-width pale card with 32px corners and a lavender wash rising from its foot: a big two-line title and grey paragraph centered on the left half, and a cluster of app UI filling the right half and running off the card's top, right and bottom edges. On phones the text sits on top with the UI below.
notes: media is a slot; empty it is a translucent white panel
